title: Two Men in Overcoats at Gran Caffe Miramare, 1950s Italy Snapshot Photo
description: Two well-dressed men in tailored overcoats and suits pose on a wide paved plaza in Lido di Ostia, Italy, during the early 1950s. The background showcases mid-century Italian architecture with storefront signage for 'Gran Caffe Miramare', 'INA', and 'Banco di Santo Spirito', alongside vintage automobiles parked along the square.
